notes: Researched 27 Sep 2026 (Asia/Kolkata). Source S1 is NTA's own press release of 20 April 2026, linked from https://jeemain.nta.nic.in/ as 'Declaration of the Result/NTA Scores for the Joint Entrance Examination [JEE (Main) - 2026] of Paper 1 (B.E. / B.Tech.) - reg.' (host cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in is the NIC S3WaaS store behind jeemain.nta.nic.in; *.gov.in = official in src/lib/official-source.ts). Page 3 prints: 'The Category-wise Cut-off of NTA Score for candidates to become eligible for JEE (Advanced) - 2026 for Paper 1 (B.E/ B.Tech.) is given below:-' followed by a table S.No | Category | Percentile (From, To) | Candidates. 'marks' is the 'To' column (the lowest NTA score of the eligible band, i.e. the cut-off); the 'From' column and the candidate count are in the evidence line only. Values were read by eye off a 200-dpi render of page 3 (scratchpad jee_cut_zoom.png) — the PDF is a scan with NO text layer (pdftotext returns nothing), so scripts/import-official-cutoffs.ts cannot prove these rows and will print FAIL for every one; by rule there is no OCR. A second, independent blocker: MARKS_RE in src/lib/official-cutoffs.ts accepts at most 6 decimals and NTA prints 7 (93.4123549). Nothing here is written until the importer gains a reviewed path for scanned official documents and 7-decimal NTA scores — the main session's call. No text-layer copy of this table was found on jeemain.nta.nic.in or nta.ac.in on 27 Sep 2026.
